raw_segments.text: Free people, and ye too, jackals of Shere Khan, for twelve seasons I have led ye to
and from the kill, and in all that time not one has been trapped or maimed.
Now I have missed my kill.
You know how that plot was made.
You know how ye brought me up to an untried buck to make my weakness known.
Your right is to kill me here on the council rock now.
Therefore I ask, who comes to make an end of the lone wolf?
For it is my right, by the law of the jungle, that ye come one by one.
